brief.title: Segment raw byte streams into lossless variable-length patches at conditional entropy spikes
brief.plain_summary: Compute predictive conditional byte Shannon entropy H(b_t | context) and segment streams into variable-length patches whenever global entropy or entropy delta spikes exceed grid thresholds.
brief.outcome: Lossless variable-length byte patches with per-patch entropy and cumulative surprise profiles.
